modmenu.descriptionTranslation.bloodvign: Pulsaerbloedrooi vignette en waarskuwingikoon by lae gesondheid.
config.bloodvignette.title: Blood Vignette-instellings
config.bloodvignette.enable_vignette.too: Wys 'n pulserende rooi vignette aan die skermrande by lae gesondheid.
config.bloodvignette.health_threshold.to: Effekte skakel aan wanneer gesondheid op of onder hierdie waarde is (1–20). Verstek 6 = 3 harte.
config.bloodvignette.heartbeat_volume.to: How loud the heartbeat is. 1 is full volume, 0 is silent.
config.bloodvignette.icon_opacity.toolti: Hoe ondeursigtig die waarskuwingikoon is (0.0 = onsigbaar, 1.0 = ten volle sigbaar).
config.bloodvignette.icon_pos_y.tooltip: Vertikale posisie (0.0 = bo, 0.18 = boonste deel, 1.0 = onder).
config.bloodvignette.fade_in_ms.tooltip: Hoe lank vignette en ikoon neem om te verskyn (0–2000 ms). 0 = dadelik.
config.bloodvignette.fade_out_ms.tooltip: Hoe lank vignette en ikoon neem om te verdwyn (0–2000 ms). 0 = dadelik.
config.bloodvignette.position_editor.des: Size, position and opacity are set in the editor. Enable the option below, then click Save & Quit.
config.bloodvignette.position_editor.ope: Turn ON, then click Save & Quit — the editor opens.
config.bloodvignette.position_editor.hin: Drag the icon with LMB. Coarse buttons ±10 / ±1, fine ±0.1 (field 0–1000).
config.bloodvignette.position_editor.uns: Leave without saving? Changes will be lost.
config.bloodvignette.vignette_opacity.to: How strong the red edge effect looks. 1 is full, 0 turns it invisible.
config.bloodvignette.enable_heartbeat.to: Turns the heartbeat audio on or off when your health is low.
